card.architecture: ChronoEdit-14B (NVIDIA) — Wan2.1-I2V 14B backbone repurposed for editing; UMT5-XXL encoder + Wan 2.1 VAE + CLIP-ViT-H clip-vision. The source image conditions a short trajectory and the LAST frame is kept as the edit. fp8; distilled LoRA for the 20-step/CFG4 path. Native ComfyUI nodes.
card.summary: NVIDIA's temporal-reasoning editor on a Wan 14B backbone (same class as your Wan 2.2). Physically-consistent edits; reuses the Wan UMT5 encoder + Wan 2.1 VAE already installed. fp8 ~16GB.
use_cases: physically-plausible instruction edits (add/remove/move objects, lighting, materials)
card.pick_when: You want NVIDIA's ChronoEdit temporal-reasoning editor; reuses your Wan stack and runs at 20 steps with the distill LoRA.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative edit instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Remove the car from the driveway and add a parked bicycle
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions; ChronoEdit reasons over a short frame trajectory and returns the final edited frame.

negative.note: Uses the Wan quality/motion negative; CFG 4 with the distill LoRA.

speed.note: 14B Wan-class fp8; ~20 steps with distill LoRA.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction (Wan-backbone, last-frame result).

edit_use_cases: temporal-reasoning instruction editing on a Wan 14B backbone: add/remove/move, relight, material changes with physical plausibility
